title: Does Inhaled Busedonide or Fluticasone Impair Adrenal Function?
brief_summary: Inhaled corticosteroids are largely used in patients with asthma or chronic obstructive lung diseases. The purpose of this study is to determine if the use of inhaled corticosteroids is associated with suppression of endogenous cortisol production, as seen in patients treated with pharmacologic doses of oral or parenteral steroids.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients receiving inhaled busedonide or fluticasone at daily dose of 200-800 mcg ' for at least 4 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients receiving any corticosteroid therapy, except inhaled busedonide or fluticasone.
